'''Carl Mike Hardy Corvette Summer''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Corvette Summer'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it in 1999.

* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 1999 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Corvette Summer
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE Corvette Summer Hardy LS 1999 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This is a very old deck design, with a few Special Edition updates. It's strength is the fact is uses cheap, tough and highly forfiet Corellian Corvettes instead of Starfighters which can be Tallon Rolled. It also uses Undercover Spies to hinder Dark Side Ground Force drains. The Mains are included to provide punch when the Dark speads beyond your spy net... The It Could Be Worses cover the rest of the possible Force loss this deck could run across. While it's style is antiquated, it still has punch and can probably surprise your opponent!
